reviews.text:
I’ve taken my cockapoo, Clark, to Happy Pets Grooming on multiple occasions, and every experience has been wonderful!

Having tried other grooming salons in the past, I can confidently say that the quality of care here really stands out. Clark has unfortunately experienced razor burns and skin irritation after grooming elsewhere, but we’ve never encountered those issues at Happy Pets Grooming. That level of care and attention makes a tremendous difference to me as a dog parent.

Their groomers are knowledgeable, skilled, gentle, and clearly experienced in working with different coat types. Cockapoos can have particular grooming needs, and I really appreciate knowing that Clark is in capable hands.

Sonia ( the store owner) is also incredibly knowledgeable and always happy to offer thoughtful suggestions about grooming styles and what might work best for Clark’s coat. I love that the recommendations are practical, personalized, and genuinely helpful.

The entire experience is well organized and professional. Appointments run smoothly, wait times are minimal, and the service has consistently been top-notch. I’d definitely recommend booking in advance!

Above all, I appreciate the kindness, patience, and genuine care that goes into looking after our furry family members. Finding groomers you can trust is incredibly important, and I’m so grateful to have found Happy Pets Grooming.

Highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality grooming services and people who truly care about their four-legged clients! ❤️🐾

I recently brought my senior dog Emma for grooming, and I am so impressed with the care she received. Emma is older and has a lot of health issues, so I’m always nervous about leaving her. The groomer was incredibly gentle, patient, and took the time to make sure she was comfortable throughout the entire appointment. They trimmed her nails, gave her a soft bath, and styled her coat beautifully without stressing her out. Finding a groomer in Toronto who truly understands the needs of senior dogs is rare, and I’m so grateful I found this place. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for professional, compassionate dog grooming in Toronto.
